assumes.ja: フルチャージの発ごとに、残りの HP の割合が最も低い味方 3 機（回復の時の HP の割合の低い順。並んだときは枠の若い順。自分も候補。C-0567）への 1 回の回復で、受けた味方の「回復効果が適用された時」を起こす。満タンの味方にも起きる。実機では被弾で HP の割合が下がった味方が選ばれうる。回復量は、最大HP のみ▲・現在の HP▼ で下がった HP の割合を戻す分だけ効く（与えるHP回復量▲・受けるHP回復量▲は掛けない。plan/design-hp-heal-restore.md 2.2 節）
assumes.en: On every fully charged shot, a one-off heal on the three allies with the lowest remaining HP ratio (lowest ratio at the heal; ties go to the leftmost slots; self included; C-0567), triggering "when healed" on those allies, also at full HP. In game, allies whose HP ratio dropped from damage can be chosen instead. The amount matters only by raising back an HP ratio lowered by max-HP-only ups or current HP downs (Outgoing/Incoming Healing ups are not applied; plan/design-hp-heal-restore.md 2.2)

notes.ja: 最終攻撃力が最も高い味方 2 機への最大HP▲と受けるHP回復量▲（どちらも 15 秒）は、それ自体は与ダメージを変えない（HP を読む効果のある編成でだけ効く）。説明文にきっかけが無い
notes.en: The Max HP increase and the Incoming Healing increase (both 15 s) on the two allies with the highest final ATK do not change damage by themselves (they matter only with an effect reading HP in the team). The description gives no trigger

assumes.ja: 味方全体への 1 回の回復（スキル発動者の最終最大HP の X%）。受けた味方の「回復効果が適用された時」を起こす。満タンの味方にも起きる。付く時刻はモデルのバーストの使用のフレーム（ラプンツェルのバーストの効果の付き始めは測っていない）。回復量は、最大HP のみ▲・現在の HP▼ で下がった HP の割合を戻す分だけ効く（与えるHP回復量▲・受けるHP回復量▲は掛けない。plan/design-hp-heal-restore.md 2.2 節）
assumes.en: A one-off heal on all allies (X% of the caster's final max HP), triggering "when healed" on the allies that receive it, also at full HP. Applied at the model's burst use frame (when Rapunzel's burst effects actually start is not measured). The amount matters only by raising back an HP ratio lowered by max-HP-only ups or current HP downs (Outgoing/Incoming Healing ups are not applied; plan/design-hp-heal-restore.md 2.2)

notes.ja: 戦闘不能状態の、最終攻撃力が最も高い味方 1 機の復活は、味方が倒れないので起きない（要件 4.2 節）
notes.en: Reviving the defeated ally with the highest final ATK does not occur, since allies are not defeated (requirements 4.2)

notes.ja: 自分の HP が 30% 以下の時の、敵全体の気絶（1 秒）はダメージに関係しない
notes.en: Stun on all enemies (1 s) while own HP is 30% or less does not affect damage
